name: Zoomies
rule: Zoomies is inert for the kiwi cat - it ignores the burst and does not speed up; after a double meow every 12 s, the cat simply keeps following
counter_play: no burst exists for the kiwi cat (its behavior cancels any active burst every tick), so it never exceeds its 0.20 ceiling (1.8 u/s, SR-5) whether Zoomies is held or not - gain height (it rises 2.0 u/s, SR-1) or hurdle it as it arrives
